name: elegant-coffee
description: Explore Elegant Coffee's published catalog of coffee machines, grinders, brewing equipment, accessories and coffee. Search by name or category, sort products, check current EUR prices and availability, and inspect product specifications and variants. Prepare a cart link for selected available variants, then review the cart, sign in and pay on the Elegant Coffee website through Stripe Checkout. The plugin does not place orders, process payments, access order history, issue refunds or control coffee machines. Catalog availability changes; checkout rechecks prices and availability.

defaultPrompt: Show me coffee machines that are in stock
Compare two espresso machines side by side

positive.description: What the shop sells and how ordering works
positive.prompt: What does Elegant Coffee sell, and how do I order?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the shop's categories (Coffee machines, Grinders, Manual brewing, Accessories), says prices are in EUR, and explains that ChatGPT can build a cart link: the customer opens it on elegant-coffee.com, signs in and pays there.

positive.description: Find in-stock products in a category (Espresso machines)
positive.prompt: Show me espresso machines from Elegant Coffee that are in stock.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists in-stock products from the Espresso machines category, such as the Eagle One, with their prices in EUR and links to their pages on elegant-coffee.com.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the Eagle One from Elegant Coffee: what it is, its price, and which versions are available.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Eagle One and shows its description, its price in EUR, whether it is in stock, and its versions.

positive.prompt: Compare the Eagle One and the Venus Bar from Elegant Coffee. Which one should I choose?
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up both products and compares their descriptions, prices in EUR and availability side by side, without claiming anything the catalog does not say.

positive.prompt: I want to buy one Eagle One from Elegant Coffee, the 2-group version in stainless steel. Put it in a cart and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the product, then returns a link to a cart on elegant-coffee.com filled with that version (SKU EC-VA-EAGLEONE-2G), and says the customer reviews the cart, signs in and pays on the shop — nothing is bought inside ChatGPT.

negative.prompt: How often should I descale my espresso machine, and how do I do it at home?

negative.description: Order status and account history — the app cannot see orders or accounts
negative.prompt: Where is my order from last week? It still hasn't arrived.
Find me a cheap flight from Sofia to Lisbon next weekend.

review.commerce_description: Helps people find Elegant Coffee's physical products and builds a link to a pre-filled cart on elegant-coffee.com, the merchant's own website. Checkout happens only there: the customer reviews the cart, signs in and pays with Stripe Checkout in EUR. Nothing is bought, and no payment or personal data is handled, inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release of Elegant Coffee for ChatGPT: search the catalog, see product details, prices in EUR and availability, and get a link to a pre-filled cart on elegant-coffee.com, where you sign in and pay.
